definitions.explanation: A fundamental, unchanging principle or fact; often used in philosophical or religious contexts.

examples.japanese: {科学|かがく}は{真理|しんり}を{追求|ついきゅう}する。
{永遠|えいえん}の{真理|しんり}を{求|もと}める。
それが{真理|しんり}であることは{誰|だれ}も{否定|ひてい}できない。
examples.english: No one can deny that it is the truth.

notes:
{真理|しんり} refers to fundamental, philosophical, or religious truth.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真理|しんり}を{追求|ついきゅう}する (pursue the truth)
- {永遠|えいえん}の{真理|しんり} (eternal truth)
- {普遍的|ふへんてき}な{真理|しんり} (universal truth)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {真理|しんり}: philosophical/universal truth
- {事実|じじつ}: fact, actual happening
- {本当|ほんとう}: truth (everyday usage), reality

HOMOPHONES:
- {真理|しんり}: truth/ultimate truth
- {心理|しんり}: psychology/mental state
